The Sages taught: Always have the left … drive … away and the right draw … near, … unlike Elisha, who pushed away Gehazi with his two hands … and unlike Yehoshua ben Peraḥya, who pushed away Jesus the Nazarene with his two hands.

Gehazi … as it is written: “And Naaman said: Be content, take two talents. And he urged him, and bound two talents of silver … “And Elisha said to him: Where from, Gehazi? And he said: Your servant went nowhere at all. And he said to him: Went not my heart with you, when the man turned back from his chariot to meet you? Is it the time to receive silver and to receive garments, and olive groves, and vineyards, and sheep and cattle, and menservants and maidservants?” … And did … take all that? It is … silver and garments that he took.

Rabbi Yitzḥak says: … At that moment, Elisha was sitting and teaching … eight … creeping animals. … Naaman, the general of the army of Aram, was a leper. A certain young Jewish woman who had been taken captive from Eretz Yisrael said to him: If you go to Elisha, he will heal you. When … came … said to him: Go immerse in the Jordan. … said to him: Are you mocking me … Those … who were with … said to him: What is the difference to you? Go, try … went and immersed in the Jordan and was healed. … came … brought to … all those … that he had … did not agree to receive … from him. Gehazi took leave from before Elisha … went … took … what he took, and … deposited

When … came, Elisha saw the leprosy that had grown on … head. … said to him: Wicked one! The time has arrived to take … reward for … the eight creeping animals. … “The leprosy of Naaman shall cleave to you and to your seed forever. And he went out of his presence a leper as white as snow” … “And there were four men afflicted with leprosy at the entrance of the gate” … Rabbi Yoḥanan says: … Gehazi and his three sons,

What is … Yehoshua ben Peraḥya? … When King Yannai was killing the Sages, Yehoshua ben Peraḥya and Jesus, … went to Alexandria of Egypt. When there was peace … Shimon ben Shataḥ sent … to … From me, Jerusalem, the holy city, to you, Alexandria of Egypt: My sister, my husband is located among you and I sit desolate.

arose, came, and happened … a certain inn … They treated him with great honor. … said: How beautiful is this inn. … said to him: … my teacher, the eyes of … are narrow [terutot]. … said to him: Wicked one! … you involve yourself with regard to that … He produced four hundred shofarot and ostracized him.

came before … several times … said to him: Accept our, … took no notice of him. One day … was reciting Shema … came before him … intended to accept his … signaled him with his hand … thought: He is driving me away. He went … stood a brick … and he bowed to it. … said to … Repent. … said to him: This … I received from you: Whoever sins and causes the masses to sin is not given the opportunity to repent. And the Master says: Jesus performed sorcery, incited … and led Israel astray.
It is taught … Rabbi Shimon ben Elazar says: … inclination, … a child, and … a woman, have the left … drive … away and the right draw … near.

The Sages taught: Elisha fell ill with three illnesses: One … that he incited bears to … children … and one … that he pushed Gehazi away with two hands … and one … from which he died, as it is stated: “And Elisha was fallen ill of his illness

Until … Abraham there was no aging, … Anyone who saw Abraham said: That is Isaac, … anyone who saw Isaac said: That is Abraham. Abraham prayed for mercy, that he would undergo aging, as it is stated: “And Abraham was old, well stricken in age” … Until … Jacob there was no weakness, … prayed for mercy and there was weakness, as it is stated: “And one said to Joseph: Behold, your father is ill” … Until … Elisha, there was no ill person who recovered, and Elisha came and prayed for mercy and recovered, as it is stated: “And Elisha was fallen ill of his illness from which he was to die”

MISHNA: … the generation of the flood have no share in the World-to-Come and will not stand in judgment … as it is stated: “My soul shall not abide [yadon] in man forever” … neither … judgment [din] nor … souls … the generation of the dispersion have no share in the World-to-Come, as it is stated: “And the Lord scattered them from there upon the face of all the earth” … and it is written: “And from there did the Lord scatter them … “And the Lord scattered them” … in this world; “and from there did the Lord scatter them” … for the World-to-Come. The people of Sodom have no share in the World-to-Come, as it is stated: “And the men of Sodom were wicked and sinners before the Lord exceedingly” … “Wicked” … in this world; “and sinners” … for the World-to-Come. But they will stand in judgment
Rabbi Neḥemya says: … these, … and those, … will not stand in judgment, as it is stated: “Therefore the wicked shall not stand

in judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous” … “Therefore the wicked shall not stand in judgment”; this … the generation of the flood, … “Nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous”; these are the people of Sodom, … said to … They will not stand … in the congregation of the righteous, but they will stand … in the congregation of the wicked.

The spies … have no share in the World-to-Come, as it is stated: “And those men who spread the evil report about the land died by plague before the Lord” … “And…died” … in this world; “by plague” … for the World-to-Come.

the generation of the wilderness have no share in the World-to-Come and will not stand in judgment, as it is stated: “In this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die” … the statement of Rabbi Akiva. Rabbi Eliezer says: … about them … says: “Gather My pious together to Me, those that have entered into My covenant by offering”

The assembly of Korah is not destined to arise … as it is stated: “And the earth closed upon them” … in this world, … “And they perished from among the assembly” … in the World-to-Come; … the statement of Rabbi Akiva. Rabbi Eliezer says: About them … says: “The Lord kills and makes alive; He lowers to the grave, and raises”

GEMARA: The Sages taught … the generation of the flood have no share in the World-to-Come, as it is stated: “And He obliterated every living thing that was upon the face of the ground, … “And He obliterated every living thing” … in this world, … “and they were obliterated from the earth” … for the World-to-Come; … the statement of Rabbi Akiva. Rabbi Yehuda ben Beteira says: … neither live nor be judged, as it is stated: “My soul shall not abide [yadon] in man forever” … neither … judgment [din], nor … souls … Alternatively, “My soul shall not abide” … their souls will not return to their sheaths [nadan],

Rabbi Menaḥem, son of Rabbi Yosef, says: Even at a time when the Holy One, Blessed be He, restores souls to lifeless corpses, … will … them harshly … in Gehenna, as it is stated: “You shall conceive chaff; you shall bring forth straw; your soul is a fire that shall devour you”

The Sages taught … The generation of the flood became haughty … due only to the … goodness that the Holy One, Blessed be He, bestowed upon them. And what is written concerning them, … “Their houses are safe without fear, nor is the rod of God upon them” … And it is written: “Their bull sires, and will not fall; their cow calves, and does not cast her calf” … And it is written: “They send forth their little ones like a flock, and their children dance” … And it is written: “They sing to the timbrel and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the pipe” … And it is written: “They shall spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures” … And it is written: “And peacefully they go down to the grave”

And that … caused … to say to God: “Depart from us; for we desire not the knowledge of Your ways. What is the Almighty, that we should serve Him, and what profit should we have if we pray unto Him” … said: Do we need Him for anything, even for … drop of rain … We have rivers and springs from which we take our supply … The Holy One, Blessed be He, said: With the goodness that I bestowed upon them, with … they infuriate Me and with it I will sentence them, as it is stated: “And behold I will bring the flood of water”

Rabbi Yosei says: The generation of the flood became haughty due only to the … eyeball, which is similar to water, as it is stated: … and they took for themselves wives from anyone they chose” … Consequently, … punished them with water, which is similar to an eyeball [legalgal ha’ayin], as it is stated: “All the fountains [mayenot] of the great deep were breached, and the flues of heaven were opened”

Rabbi Yoḥanan says: … the generation of the flood sinned with “great” and were punished with “great.” They sinned with “great,” as it is stated: “And the Lord saw that the wickedness of man was great” … And they were punished with great, as it is stated: “All the fountains of the great deep … Rabbi Yoḥanan says: Three … of … remained, … Beloa of Gader, and the hot springs of Tiberias, and the great spring of Beiram.

“For all flesh had corrupted its way upon the earth” … Rabbi Yoḥanan says: … teaches that … mated … domesticated animals with … undomesticated animals, and … undomesticated animals with … domesticated animals, and all … with human … and human … with all … Rabbi Abba bar Kahana says: And … all of … returned … except … tushlami,

“And God said to Noah: The end of all flesh is come before Me, … Rabbi Yoḥanan says: Come and see how great is the power of robbery, as the generation of the flood violated every … but their sentence … was not sealed until they extended their hands … in robbery, as it is stated: “For the earth is filled with robbery through them, and behold, I will destroy them with the earth” … And it is written: “Robbery is risen up into a rod of wickedness; nothing comes from them, nor from their multitude, nor from any of them, nor shall there be wailing [no’ah] for them”

Rabbi Elazar says: … teaches that … straightened itself like a rod and stood before the Holy One, Blessed be He, and said before Him: Master of the Universe: “Nothing comes from them, nor from their multitude, nor from any of them, nor shall there be wailing for them,”

And the sentence of Noah was also sealed; … as it is stated: Nor shall there be No’aḥ for them. … The school of Rabbi Yishmael taught: The sentence of Noah was also decided; but … that he found favor in the eyes of God, as it is stated: “For I regret that I have made them. And Noah found favor in the eyes of the Lord”

“Vayyinaḥem the Lord that He made man on the earth [ba’aretz]” … When Rav Dimi came … he said … The Holy One, Blessed be He, said: I did well that I prepared graves for … in the earth [ba’aretz]. … From where … inferred … It is written here: “Vayyinaḥem,” and it is written there: “And he comforted them [vayenaḥem otam] and spoke to their heart”

And there are … who say … I did not do well that I prepared graves for … in the earth, … It is written here: “Vayyinaḥem,” and it is written there: “And the Lord regretted [vayyinaḥem] the evil that He thought to do to His people”

“These are the generations of Noah; Noah was a righteous man, and wholehearted in his generations” … Rabbi Yoḥanan says: … of his generation … but not … of other generations. And Reish Lakish says: In his generation … all the more so … in other generations.

Rabbi Ḥanina says: … a parable … of Rabbi Yoḥanan; to what is this matter comparable? … to a barrel of wine that was placed in a cellar … vinegar … in its place, its fragrance diffuses, … not in its place … its fragrance does not diffuse, … Rabbi Oshaya says: … a parable … of Reish Lakish; to what is this matter comparable? … to a flask of perfume [palyaton] that was placed in a location of filth. In its place its fragrance diffuses … and all the more so … in a location … perfume.
“And He obliterated every living thing that was upon the face of the ground, … If man sinned, … what … did … animal … sin

taught in the name of Rabbi Yehoshua ben Korḥa: … a parable … to a man who fashioned a wedding canopy for his son and prepared all sorts of … feast. Sometime … his son died. … He arose and dismantled his … wedding canopy. He said: Did I do … other than for my son? Now that … died, why do I … a wedding canopy? So too, the Holy One, Blessed be He, said: Did I create domesticated animals and non-domesticated animals … other than for man? Now that man sins … why do I … domesticated animals and non-domesticated animals?
“Of all that was on dry land died” … But not the fish that are in the sea,

Rabbi Yosei from Caesarea taught: What … which is written: “He is swift upon the face of the waters; their portion is cursed in the earth; … teaches that Noah the righteous would rebuke … and say to them: Repent. And if … not, the Holy One, Blessed be He, will bring a flood upon you and float your corpses on the water like wineskins … as it is stated: “He is swift upon the face of the waters.” Moreover, a curse is taken from them to all who enter the world, … As it is stated: “Their portion is cursed in the earth.”
“He turns not by way of the vineyards,” teaches that they would clear a path through vineyards. They said to … And who is preventing … said to them: I have one pigeon, … remove from among you
If so we will not clear a path through vineyards,

Rava taught: What … which is written: “A contemptible torch [lapid] in the thought of him that is at ease, a thing ready for them whose foot slips” … teaches that Noah the righteous would rebuke … and he said to them statements that are harsh as torches [kelapidim], and they would treat him with contempt. They said to him: Old man, why … this ark? … said to them: The Holy One, Blessed be He, is bringing a flood upon you. They said to him: A flood of what? If it is a flood of fire, we have another item and it is called alita, … And if … of water … He brings, if He brings … from the earth, we have iron plates with which we … plate the earth … And if He brings … from the heavens, we have an item and it is called ekev, and some say it is called ikkesh,

said to them: … He will bring … from between your feet … as it is stated: “For them whose foot slips.” It is taught … The waters of the flood were … hard … as semen, as it is stated: “For them whose foot slips”; … Rav Ḥisda says: With hot … they sinned, and with hot … they were punished. … it is written here, … “And the waters assuaged” … and it is written there: “Then the king’s wrath was assuaged”
“And it came to pass that after seven days the waters of the flood were upon the earth” … What is the nature of … seven … days?

Rav says: These were the days of mourning … of Methuselah; … to teach you that eulogies for the righteous prevent calamities from ensuing. Alternatively, “after seven … that the Holy One, Blessed be He, altered the order of Creation for … that the sun would emerge in the west and set in the east. Alternatively, … that the Holy One, Blessed be He, designated a substantial period for them, … and thereafter … a brief period … Alternatively, “after seven days” … that … gave them a foretaste … of the World-to-Come, … so that they would know what munificence … prevented them from

“Of every kosher animal you shall take to you by sevens, husband and wife” … Is there marriage for animals? Rabbi Shmuel bar Naḥmani says … Rabbi Yonatan says: … those … with which … transgression … was not performed.

From where did … know … Rav Ḥisda says: He passed them before the ark. All … that the ark accepted, it was known that a transgression had not been performed with them. And any … that the ark did not accept, it was known that a transgression had been performed with it. Rabbi Abbahu says: … from those … that came on their own,
“Make you an ark of gopher wood” … What … gopher … Rav Adda says … they say in the school of Rabbi Sheila: This … mavliga … and some say … willow [gulamish]

“A tzohar you shall make for the ark” … Rabbi Yoḥanan says … the Holy One, Blessed be He, said to Noah: Set precious stones and jewels in … so that they will shine for you as the afternoon [tzohorayim]
“And to a cubit you shall finish it above” … that in that manner, … stand
“With lower, second and third stories shall you make it” … taught … The bottom … for manure, the middle … for animals, and the top … for people.

“And he sent forth the raven, … Reish Lakish says: The raven … a convincing response to Noah; … said to him: Your Master, … hates me, and you hate me. Your Master hates me, … from the kosher … seven … from the non-kosher … two. And you hate me, as you disregard … from the species of seven, … and … dispatch … from the species of two, … If the angel of heat or the angel of cold harms me … will the world not be lacking one … creature, … Or perhaps … my wife … you need,
said to … Wicked one! … with … who is … permitted to me, … is forbidden to me, … with … which are … forbidden to me, … not all the more so

And from where do we … that it was prohibited … which is written: “And you shall come into the ark, you, and your sons, and your wife, and your sons’ wives with you” … and it is written: “Emerge from the ark, you and your wife, and your sons and your sons’ wives with you” … And Rabbi Yoḥanan says: From here, … said that it was prohibited … in intercourse
The Sages taught: Three … engaged in intercourse … in the ark, and all of them were punished … dog, and … raven, and Ham, … dog … is bound; … raven … spits, … Ham was afflicted in … his skin
“And he sent forth the dove from him, to see if the waters abated” … Rabbi Yirmeya says: From here … that the dwelling place of kosher birds … with the righteous

“And in her mouth was an olive branch plucked off [taraf ]” … Rabbi Elazar says: … dove said before the Holy One, Blessed be He: Master of the Universe, may my sustenance be bitter as the olive and dependent on Your hands, and not sweet as honey and dependent on the hands of flesh and blood. … From where may … be inferred that taraf is a term … sustenance? … which is written: “Feed me [hatrifeni] with my allotted portion”
“After their kinds [lemishpeḥoteihem], they emerged from the ark” … Rabbi Yoḥanan says: After their kinds [lemishpeḥotam] … but not them [hem]

Rav Ḥana bar Bizna says: Eliezer, … said to Shem the Great, … It is written: “After their kinds, they emerged from the ark,” … Where were you … said to him: We … great suffering in the ark … a creature that one typically feeds during the day, we fed it during the day, … that one typically feeds at night, we fed it at night. … that chameleon, my father did not know what it eats. One day, … was sitting and peeling a pomegranate. A worm fell from it … ate it. From that point forward … would knead bran … when it became overrun with worms, … eat

the lion, a fever sustained it, … as Rav said: … no fewer than six … and no more than twelve … fever sustains … phoenix [avarshina], my father found it lying in … the side of the ark. He said to … Do you not want food? … said to him: I saw that you were busy, … I said I would not trouble you … said to … May it be … will that you shall not die, … as it is stated: “And I said, I shall die in my nest, and I shall multiply my days as the phoenix”

Rav Ḥana bar Leva’ei says … Shem the Great said to Eliezer, … When … kings of the east and the west came upon you … what did you do? … said to him: The Holy One, Blessed be He, brought Abraham and placed him to His right, and we would throw dust and it became swords, … straw and it became arrows, as it is stated: “A Psalm of David. The Lord says to my master: Sit to My right, until I make your enemies your footstool” … and it is written: “Who has raised up one from the east at whose steps victory attends? He gives nations before him, and makes him rule over kings; his sword makes them as the dust, his bow as driven straw”
Naḥum of Gam Zo was accustomed that … any … that arose in his … would say: This too [gam zo] is for the best. One day the Jewish people sought to send a gift [doron] to the emperor. They said: With
whom shall we send … We will send … with Naḥum of Gam Zo, as he is experienced in miracles.

When he reached a certain lodging, he sought to sleep … said to him: What … have with you? … said to them: I am taking the head tax to the emperor. They rose in the night, opened his chest and took everything that was in it, and … filled … with dirt. When he arrived there, … earth was discovered … said: The Jews are mocking me … They took … out to kill him. … said: This too is for the best. Elijah … came and appeared to them as one of … said to them: Perhaps this earth is from the earth of Abraham our forefather, who would throw dust … it became swords, … straw … it became arrows. They examined … and discovered

There was a province that … were unable to conquer. They threw … of this earth upon … and they conquered it. … they brought him into the treasury … said: Take … which is preferable to you. He filled his chest … gold. When he returned … those residents said to him: What did you bring to the king’s palace? … said to them: What I took from here, I brought to there. … They took … brought it to … they executed those residents.

the generation of the dispersion have no share in the World-to-Come. … What … did they perform? … The school of Rabbi Sheila say … We will build a tower and ascend to heaven, and we will strike it with axes so that its waters will flow. They laughed at … in the West, … If … let them build … on a mountain;

Rather, Rabbi Yirmeya bar Elazar says: They divided into three factions; one said: Let us ascend … and dwell there. And one said: Let us ascend … and engage in idol worship. And one said: Let us ascend … and wage war. … that … that said: Let us ascend … and dwell there, God dispersed them. And that … that said: Let us ascend … and wage war, became apes, and spirits, and demons, and female demons. And … that … that said: Let us ascend … and engage in idol worship, … “Because there the Lord confounded the language of all the earth”

It is taught … Rabbi Natan says: All of … intended … for the sake of idol worship. It is written here: “And let us make a name for us” … and it is written there: “And make no mention of the name of the other gods” … Just as there, … is idol worship, so too here, … is idol worship.

Rabbi Yoḥanan says: The … third … tower was burned, … third … was swallowed … third remained … Rav says: The atmosphere of the tower causes forgetfulness; … Rav Yosef says: Babylonia and … Bursif, are … a bad omen for Torah, … What … Bursif? Rabbi Asi says: … empty pit [bor shafi].

The people of Sodom have no share in the World-to-Come. The Sages taught: The people of Sodom have no share in the World-to-Come, as it is stated: “And the men of Sodom were wicked and sinners before the Lord exceedingly” … “Wicked” … in this world; “and sinners” … for the World-to-Come.

Rav Yehuda says: “Wicked” … with their bodies; “and sinners” … with their money. “Wicked” … with their bodies, as it is written … “And how can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God” … “And sinners” … with their money, as it is written: … for it shall be reckoned to you as a sin” … “Before the Lord”; this … blessing, … God. “Exceedingly” … that they had intent and sinned

It was taught in a baraita: “Wicked” … with their money; “and sinners” … with their bodies. “Wicked” … with their money, as it is written: “And your eye is wicked against your poor brother … “And sinners” … with their bodies, as it is written … “And sin against God” … “Before the Lord”; this … blessing, … God. “Exceedingly [meod ]” … bloodshed, as it is stated: “Moreover Manasseh shed very [meod ] much blood”

The Sages taught: The people of Sodom became haughty … due only to the … goodness that the Holy One, Blessed be He, bestowed upon them. And what is written concerning them, … “As for the earth, out of it comes bread, and underneath it is turned up as it were by fire. Its stones are the place of sapphires, and it has dust of gold. That path no bird of prey knows, neither has the falcon’s eye seen it. The proud beasts have not trodden it, nor has the lion passed thereby”

said: Since … a land from which bread comes and has the dust of gold, … Why do we need travelers, as they come only to divest us of our property? Come, let us cause the … treatment of travelers to be forgotten from our land, as it is stated: “He breaks open a watercourse in a place far from inhabitants, forgotten by pedestrians, they are dried up, they have moved away from men”

Rava taught: What … which is written: “How long will you seek to overwhelm a man? You will all be murdered like a leaning wall or a tottering fence” … teaches that … set their sights on property owners. … and place him alongside an inclined, … wall … and push it upon him … and … they … come and take his property.

Rava taught: What … which is written: “In the dark they dig through houses; by day they shut themselves up; they know not the light” … teaches that they would set their sights on property owners. … and … give him balsam, … and … place it in his treasury. In the evening, … would come and sniff it … like a dog … as it is stated: “They return at evening; they howl like a dog, and go round about the city” … And … they would come and dig there, and they would take that property.

“They lie at night naked without clothing, and they have no covering in the cold” … “They drive away the donkey of the fatherless; they take the widow’s ox as a pledge” … “They trespass; they violently steal flocks and graze them” … “For he is brought to the grave, and watch is kept over his tomb”

Rabbi Yosei taught in Tzippori … That night three hundred tunnels were excavated in Tzippori … came and harassed him; they said to him: You have given a way for thieves … said to them: Did I know that thieves would come … When Rabbi Yosei died, the gutters of Tzippori … overflowed … blood

would say: … who has one ox shall herd … for one day. … who does not have … shall herd … for two days. … They gave oxen to a certain orphan, son of a widow, to herd. He went … took them and killed them. … said

Let … who has one ox take one hide … let … who does not have an ox take two hides. … said to … What … this? … said to them: The ultimate rule is parallel to the initial rule; just as the initial rule … who has one ox shall herd … for one day … does not have … oxen shall herd … for two days, so too, the ultimate rule … Let … who has one ox take one … let … who does not have … ox take two

Let … who crosses on a ferry give one dinar … let … who does not cross on a ferry, … give two … who had a row of bricks, each and every one … would … take one … say to him: I am taking … one, … who would cast garlic or onions … each and every … would … take one … say to him: I took … one

There were four judges in Sodom … Shakrai, … and Shakrurai, … Zayfai, … and Matzlei Dina, … one who strikes the wife of another and causes her to miscarry, they would say to … Give … to … one … so that she will be impregnated for you … who severed the ear of another’s donkey, they would say to … Give … until … grows … who wounds another, they would say … Give … a fee, as he let your blood.

who crossed … on a ferry gives four dinars, … who crossed … in the water gives eight dinars. One time a certain launderer came … arrived there. … said to him: Give four dinars … He said to them: I crossed in the water. They said to him: If so, give eight … as you crossed in the water. He did not give … wounded him. He came before the judge … said to him: Give … a fee, as he let your blood, and eight dinars, as you crossed … in the water.

Eliezer, servant of Abraham, happened … there, … they wounded him. He came before the judge … said to him: Give … a fee, as he let your blood. He took a stone … he wounded the judge. … said: What … this? … said to him: The fee that is … paid to me by you, give it to that … and my money will remain where it remains.

They had beds on which they would lay their guests; when … was longer … they … cut him, … when … was shorter … they would stretch him. Eliezer, servant of Abraham, happened … there. They said to him: Come lie on the bed. He said to them: I took a vow … since the day my mother died I do not lie on a bed.

When a poor person would happen … to … each and every … would give him a dinar, and the name of … was written on … And they would not give … him bread, … When he would die, each and every person would come and take his

This … stipulated among themselves: Whoever invites a man to a wedding, his cloak will be removed. There was this wedding, … Eliezer, … arrived there and they did not give him bread. When he sought to dine, Eliezer came and sat at the end, … everyone. They said to him: Who invited you to here? He said to the one sitting … You invited me. … said … Perhaps they will hear that I invited him and they will remove the garment of that man, … The one who sat next to him took his cloak and ran outside. And likewise, … did … for all of them until they all left, and he ate the meal.

There was a young woman who would take bread out to the poor people in a pitcher … The matter was revealed, … they smeared her with honey and positioned her on the wall … the hornets came and consumed her. And that is … which is written: “And the Lord said: Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great [rabba]” … And Rav Yehuda says … Rav says: … matter of the young woman [riva]

The spies … have no share in the World-to-Come, as it is stated: “And those men who spread the evil report about the land died by plague … “And…died” … in this world, … “by plague” … for the World-to-Come.

the assembly of Korah have no share in the World-to-Come, as it is stated: “And the earth closed upon them” … in this world, … “And they perished from among the assembly” … in the World-to-Come; … the statement of Rabbi Akiva. Rabbi Eliezer says: About … the verse states: “The Lord kills and makes alive; He lowers to the grave, and raises”

The Sages taught … the assembly of Korah have no share in the World-to-Come, as it is stated: “And the earth closed upon them” … in this world, … “And they perished from among the assembly” … in the World-to-Come; … the statement of Rabbi Akiva. Rabbi Yehuda ben Beteira says: … they are like a lost item that is sought, … as it is stated: “I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek out your servant, for I do not forget your mitzvot”

“And Korah, … took [vayikkaḥ]” … Reish Lakish says: He purchased [lakaḥ] a bad acquisition for himself, … “Korah” … that … a void [korḥa] was created in … Israel. “Son of Izhar,” … a son who incited the wrath of the entire world upon him like … the afternoon [tzohorayim]. “Son of Kohath,” … a son who blunted [hik’ha] the teeth of his parents, … “Son of Levi,” … a son who became an escort [levaya] in Gehenna.

But … let … also include: Son of Jacob [Ya’akov], … A son who contorted [she’akav] himself … Gehenna? Rav Shmuel bar Rav Yitzḥak says: Jacob prayed for mercy for himself … as it is stated: “Let my soul not come into their council; to their assembly let my honor not be united” … “Let my soul not come into their council”; these are … spies. … “To their assembly let my honor not be united”; this … the assembly of Korah.

“Dathan” … who violated the precepts [dat] of God. “Abiram” … who braced [iber] himself from repenting. “And On” … who sat in acute mourning [aninut] … “Peleth” … for whom wonders [pelaot] were performed. Son of Reuben [Reuven], … a son who saw and understood [ra’a vehevin]

Rav says: On, son of Peleth, … his wife saved him. She said to him: What is the difference to you? If … Master, … the great … you … the student. And if … Master, … the great … you … the student. … said to her: What shall I do? I was … who took counsel and I took an oath with them … She said to him: I know that the entire assembly is holy, as it is written: “For all the assembly is holy” … She said to him: Sit, for I will save you. She gave him wine to drink and caused him to become drunk and laid him … inside … She sat at the entrance
and exposed her hair … Anyone who came … saw her … back. In the meantime … was swallowed

Korah’s wife said to him: See what Moses is doing. He is the king, he appointed his brother High Priest, … he appointed his brother’s sons deputy priests. If teruma comes, he says: Let it be for the priest; if … tithe comes, which you … take, he says: Give one tenth to the priest. And furthermore, he shears your hair and waves you … as excrement … he set … sights on your hair … said to her: But didn’t he also do so; … She said to him: Since it is all … for his own prominence, he also said … “Let me die with the Philistines”

And furthermore, … which he said to you, to prepare sky-blue dye … If it enters your mind, … sky-blue dye is considered a mitzva, take out robes … of … sky-blue dye, and dress all … of your academy … This is … which is written: “The wisdom of women builds her house” … this … the wife of On, son of Peleth. … “Folly plucks it down with her hands” … this … the wife of Korah.

“And they arose before Moses, with men from the children of Israel, two hundred and fifty … the distinctive people of the assembly. “The elect men of the assembly [keri’ei moed]” … who knew … to intercalate the years and establish the months … “Men of renown [shem],” … who had a reputation [shem] throughout the world.

“And Moses heard and he fell on his face” … What report did he hear … Rabbi Shmuel bar Naḥmani says … Rabbi Yonatan says: … that they suspected him … with a married woman, as it is stated: “And they were jealous of Moses in the camp” … Rabbi Shmuel bar Yitzḥak says: … teaches that each and every … warned his wife … from Moses … as it is stated: “And Moses would take the tent and pitch it outside the camp”

“And Moses arose and went to Dathan and Abiram” … Reish Lakish says: From here … that one may not perpetuate a dispute, as Rav says: Anyone who perpetuates a dispute violates a prohibition, as it is stated: “And he will not be like Korah and his assembly,

Rav Ashi says: … is fit to be afflicted with leprosy. It is written here: “By the hand of Moses to him,” and it is written there: “And the Lord said furthermore to him: Put now your hand into your bosom.

Rabbi Yosei says: … anyone who disputes the reign of the house of David, it is fitting for a snake to bite him. … it is written here: “And Adonijah slaughtered sheep and cattle and fatlings by the stone of Zoheleth” … and it is written there: “With the poison of crawling things [zoḥalei] of the dust”

Rav Ḥisda says: Anyone who disagrees with his teacher is like one who disagrees with the Divine Presence, as it is stated … “When they strove against the Lord” … Rabbi Ḥama, son of Rabbi Ḥanina, says: Anyone who initiates a quarrel [meriva] with his teacher is like one who initiates a quarrel with the Divine Presence, as it is stated: “These are the waters of Meribah, where the children of Israel quarreled with the Lord”

Rabbi Ḥanina bar Pappa says: Anyone who expresses resentment against his teacher … it is as though he is expressing resentment against the Divine Presence, as it is stated: “Your murmurings are not against us, but against the Lord” … Rabbi Abbahu says: Anyone who suspects his teacher … it is as though he suspects the Divine Presence, as it is stated: “And the people spoke against God, and against Moses”

“Wealth is kept for the owner to his detriment” … Reish Lakish says: This … the wealth of Korah, … “And all the substance that was at their feet” … Rabbi Elazar says: This … a person’s property, which stands him on his feet. And Rabbi Levi says: The keys … to Korah’s treasury were a burden … three hundred white mules … and … all the keys [aklidei] and locks were of leather.

Rabbi Ḥama, son of Rabbi Ḥanina, says: Joseph concealed three buried treasures in Egypt … one was revealed to Korah, and … one was revealed to Antoninus, son of Asveirus, … and one … hidden for the righteous in the future,

And Rabbi Yoḥanan says: Korah was neither among the swallowed nor among the burned; … neither among the swallowed, as it is written: … and all the men who were with Korah” … But not Korah … Nor … among the burned, as it is written: “When the fire consumed two hundred and fifty men” … but not Korah.

was taught in a baraita: Korah was … among the burned and among the swallowed. … among the swallowed, as it is written: … and swallowed them with Korah” … among the burned, as it is written: “And fire came forth from the Lord, and devoured the two hundred and fifty men … and Korah was with them.

Rava says: What … which is written: “The sun and moon stand still in their habitation [zevula], at the light of Your arrows as they go” … teaches that the sun and moon ascended to zevul, … They said before … Master of the Universe, if You perform justice for … the son of Amram, … we will emerge … And if not, we will not emerge. … until … fired arrows at them … said to them: You did not protest with regard to My honor, … you protested for the honor of flesh and blood? And today, … do not emerge until they are struck,

Rava taught: What … which is written: “But if the Lord creates a new creation and the earth opens its mouth” … Moses said before the Holy One, Blessed be He: If Gehenna is … created, good, but if not, God should create … For what … If we say … to actually create … but isn’t … “There is nothing new under the sun” … Rather, … to bring the opening … close

“And the sons of Korah did not die” … taught … in the name of our teacher, … said: A place was fortified for them in Gehenna and they sat upon it and recited songs … Rabba bar bar Ḥana said: One time I was walking on the path, … a certain Arab said to me: Come and I will show you those … of Korah … swallowed. I went … I saw two fissures … from which smoke was emerging. … took a woolen fleece … dampened it with water and placed it on the tip of his spear and passed … there. … was singed, … He said to me: Listen; what do you hear? And I heard that this … they were saying: Moses and his Torah are truth, and they, … are liars.
said to him: Every thirty days Gehenna returns them … like meat … in a cauldron, and they say this: Moses and his Torah are truth, and they are liars.

the generation of the wilderness have no share in the World-to-Come. The Sages taught: … the generation of the wilderness have no share in the World-to-Come, as it is stated: “In this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die” … “They shall be consumed” … in this world; “and there they shall die” … for the World-to-Come. And … states … “Wherefore I took an oath in My anger that they should not enter into My rest” … the statement of Rabbi Akiva.

Rabbi Eliezer says: They come to the World-to-Come, as it is stated: “Gather My pious together to Me, those that have entered into My covenant by offering” … But how do I realize … “Wherefore I took an oath in My anger”? … In My anger I took an oath, and I reconsidered

Rabbi Yehoshua ben Korḥa says: This verse was stated … only with regard to future generations, … “Gather My pious together to Me”; these are the righteous that are in each and every generation. “Those that have entered into My covenant by offering”; these are Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah, who submitted themselves to the fiery furnace … “By offering”; this is … Rabbi Akiva and his colleagues, who gave themselves up to slaughter over matters of Torah.

Rabbi Shimon ben Menasya says: … comes to the World-to-Come, as it is stated: “And the redeemed of the Lord shall return and come singing into Zion” … Rabba bar bar Ḥana says … Rabbi Yoḥanan says: Rabbi Akiva abandoned his piety … as it is stated … “Go and cry in the ears of Jerusalem saying, … I remember for you the affection of your youth, the love of your espousals, how you went after Me in the wilderness, in a land that was not sown” … Now, if others come … in the merit of … not all the more so … themselves

MISHNA: The ten tribes are not destined to return … as it is stated: “And He cast them into another land, as it is this day” … Just as the day passes never to return, so too, … go … and do not return; … the statement of Rabbi Akiva. Rabbi Eliezer says: “As it is this day,” … just as the day darkens and … brightens … the ten tribes as well, … it is dark for them … so it is destined to brighten for them.

GEMARA: The Sages taught … The ten tribes have no share in the World-to-Come, as it is stated: “And the Lord rooted them out of their land in anger, and in wrath, and in great indignation; … “And the Lord rooted them out of their land” … in this world; “and cast them into another land” … for the World-to-Come; … the statement of Rabbi Akiva. Rabbi Shimon ben Yehuda of the village of Akko says in the name of Rabbi Shimon: If their actions … “as it is this day” … they do not return … And if not, … they return

Rabbi … says: … come to the World-to-Come, as it is stated: “And it shall come to pass on that day, that a great shofar will be sounded, … Rabba bar bar Ḥana says … Rabbi Yoḥanan says: … Rabbi Akiva abandoned his piety … as it is stated … “Go and proclaim these words toward the north, and say: Return you faithless Israel, says the Lord; I will not frown upon you; for I am merciful, says the Lord, and I will not bear a grudge forever”

What is the … piety of … as it is taught … The minor children of the wicked of the Jewish people, … do not come into the World-to-Come, as it is stated: “For behold the day is coming; it burns like a furnace, and all the arrogant and all who do wickedly shall be straw; and the day that is coming shall burn them up, says the Lord of hosts, so that it will leave them neither root nor branch” … a root in this world … a branch in the World-to-Come; … the statement of Rabban Gamliel.

Rabbi Akiva says: They come into the World-to-Come, as it is stated: “The Lord preserves the simple [peta’im]” … as in the cities overseas … call a child patya. And … states … “Hew down the tree and destroy it; yet leave the stump of its roots in the earth” … But how do I realize … “So that it will leave them neither root nor branch”? … will not leave for … a mitzva nor the remnants of a mitzva … Alternatively, “root”; this … soul. “Nor branch”; this … the body.

But everyone agrees … the minor children of the wicked of the nations of the world will not come into the World-to-Come, … And Rabban Gamliel derives … from … “And you have caused all their memory to perish”

It was stated: … a minor … from when, … does he come into the World-to-Come? … Rabbi Ḥiyya and Rabbi Shimon bar Rabbi … One … says: From the moment that he is born, and … one says: From the moment that … talk. … The one who says: From the moment that he is born, … that … is stated: “They shall come and shall declare His righteousness to a people that shall be born, that He has done this” … And the one who says: From the moment that … talk, … that … is written: “Their seed shall serve Him; it shall be told of the Lord to the coming generation”

It was stated … Ravina says: From the moment that … is conceived, … as it is written: “Their seed shall serve Him” … Rabbi Naḥman bar Yitzḥak says: From the moment that he is circumcised, as it is written: “I am poor and close to death from youth; I suffered your terrors [emekha], I am numb”

taught in the name of Rabbi Meir: From the moment that … will say amen, as it is stated: “Open the gates, so that the righteous nation that keeps faithfulness may enter” … Do not read … “that keeps faithfulness [shomer emunim]”; rather, … That says amen [she’omer amen].
What … amen? Rabbi Ḥanina says: … God, faithful King [El Melekh ne’eman].

“Therefore, the netherworld has enlarged itself and opened its mouth without measure [livli ḥok]” … Reish Lakish says: … one who leaves even one statute [ḥok] … Rabbi Yoḥanan says: It is not satisfactory to … their Master, that you said this about them, … Rather, even if one learned only one statute,

that … is stated: “And it shall come to pass that in all the land, says the Lord, two parts shall be excised and die, but the third shall remain in it” … Reish Lakish says: … one-third … of Shem, … Rabbi Yoḥanan said to … It is not satisfactory to … their Master, that you said this about them, … Rather, even … one-third … of Noah,

“For I have taken you to Myself: And I will take out one of a city, and two of a family” … Reish Lakish says: … statement … as it is written, … Rabbi Yoḥanan said to him: It is not satisfactory to … their Master, that you said this about them. Rather, … one from the city causes the entire city … benefit, and … two from a family causes the entire family … benefit … Rav Kahana sat before Rav, and sat and said: … this statement … as it is written. Rav said to him: It is not satisfactory to … their Master, that you said this about them. Rather, … one from the city causes the entire city … benefit, and … two from a family causes the entire family … benefit

saw that … was washing … his head and … arose and sat before Rav. … said to … “Nor shall it be found in the land of the living [haḥayyim]” … he said to … Are you cursing me? … said to him: … a verse … I am saying … Torah will not be found in one who sustains [meḥayye] himself … in its

It is taught … Rav Simai says … it is stated: “And I will take you to Me as a people” … and … it is stated: “And I will bring you … compares their exodus from Egypt to their entry into the land; just as … their entry into the land … two of six hundred thousand … so too, … their exodus from Egypt, … only two of six hundred thousand … Rava says: And likewise, … in the messianic era, as it is stated: “And she shall respond there, as in the days of her youth, and as in the day when she came up out of the land of Egypt”

It is taught … Rabbi Elazar, son of Rabbi Yosei, says: One time I entered Alexandria of Egypt. I found one old man and he said to me: Come and I will show you what my ancestors, … did to your ancestors, … of them they drowned in the sea, … of them they killed with the sword, … some of them they crushed in the buildings. And … over this matter, … Moses, our teacher, was punished, as it is stated: “For since I came to Pharaoh to speak in Your name, he has done evil to this people,

The Holy One, Blessed be He, said to … Woe over those who are gone and are no … found; as several times I revealed Myself to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob as God Almighty [El Shaddai] and they did not question My attributes, and did not say to Me: What is Your name? I said to Abraham: “Arise, walk through the land in the length of it and in the breadth of it; for unto you I will give it” … he sought a place to bury Sarah and did not find … until he purchased … for four hundred silver shekels, and he did not question My attributes

I said to Isaac: “Sojourn in this land, and I will be with you and will bless you” … His servants sought water to drink and they did not find … until they started a quarrel, as it is stated: “And the herdsmen of Gerar quarreled with Isaac’s herdsmen saying: The water is ours” … and he did not question My attributes.

I said to Jacob: “The land upon which you lie, to you I will give it” … He sought a place to pitch his tent and he did not find … until he purchased … for one hundred coins, and he did not question My attributes, and did not say to Me: What is Your name? And you, … ask Me: What is Your name, initially, … And now you say to Me: “Neither have You delivered Your people” … “Now shall you see what I will do to Pharaoh” … The war with Pharaoh … you … see, but you will not see the war with the thirty-one kings
and Moses made haste and bowed his head toward the earth and prostrated himself” … What did Moses see

Rabbi Ḥanina ben Gamla says: He saw … slow to anger; and the Rabbis say: He saw … truth. It is taught … in accordance with … the one who said: He saw … slow to anger, as it is taught … When Moses ascended on high, he discovered the Holy One, Blessed be He, sitting and writing: Slow to anger. … said before Him: Master of the Universe, … slow to anger … for the righteous? … said to him: … even for the wicked. … said to Him: Let the wicked be doomed. … said to him: Now, you … see that you will need
When the Jewish people sinned … said to … Didn’t you say to Me … slow to anger … for the righteous

said before Him: Master of the Universe, and isn’t this … You said to me: … even for the wicked? And that is … which is written: “And now, I pray You, let the power of my Lord be great, as You have spoken, saying”

Rabbi Ḥagga was walking up the stairs in the school of Rabba bar Sheila. He heard a certain child who said: “Your testimonies are very sure; sanctity becomes Your house, Lord, for the length of days” … And juxtaposed to it … “A prayer of Moses” … said: Conclude from it … slow to anger … saw.

Rabbi Elazar says … Rabbi Ḥanina says: The Holy One, Blessed be He, is destined to be a crown on the head of each and every righteous … as it is stated: “In that day shall the Lord of hosts be for a crown of glory, and for a diadem of beauty, unto the remnant of His people” … What is … “For a crown of glory, and for a diadem of beauty”? … for those who perform His will and … for those who await His salvation. … might … to everyone … the verse states: “Unto the remnant of His people,” … to one who … establishes himself like a remnant,

“And for a spirit of justice to him that sits in judgment and for strength to them who retaliate in battle to the gate” … “And for a spirit of justice”; this … one who subdues his … inclination … “To him that sits in judgment”; this … one who judges a true judgment truthfully. “And for strength”; this … one who overcomes his … inclination. “Them who retaliate in battle”; this … who gives and takes … in the battle, … of Torah. “To the gate” … those … who arrive early and remain late within … synagogues and study halls.

The attribute of justice said before the Holy One, Blessed be He: Master of the Universe, how do these … differ from those … said to … “These also reel through wine, and stagger through strong drink…they stumble [paku] in judgment [peliliyya]” … And puka … nothing other than Gehenna, as it is stated: “That this shall not be a cause of stumbling [puka] for you” … And … pelila … nothing other than judges, as it is stated: “And he shall pay as the judges [biflilim] determine”

MISHNA: The residents of an idolatrous city have no share in the World-to-Come, as it is stated: “Certain men, wicked persons, are gone out from your midst, and have subverted the inhabitants of their city, saying: … And … are not executed … unless its subverters are from that city and from that tribe, and unless most of … are subverted, and unless men subvert … women or children subvert … or that a minority of … were subverted, or that its subverters were from outside … these … are … as individuals. And … one requires two witnesses and forewarning for each and every one

This is a stringency with regard to individuals … than … with regard to multitudes … As the individuals … by stoning; therefore, … their property is spared … And the multitudes … by the sword; … their property is eliminated.
“You shall smite the inhabitants of that city with the edge of the sword” … the caravan of donkeys and the caravan of camels that move from place to place, these … save

It is stated: “Destroy it utterly, and all that is in it and its animals, with the edge of the sword” … From here, … stated: The property of the righteous, … that is inside … is destroyed … that is outside … is spared. And … of the wicked, whether … inside … or whether it is outside … these … are destroyed.
It is stated: “And you shall gather all of its spoils into the midst of its square” … If … has no square, one creates a square for … If there was a square outside of … they bring it inside

It is stated … “And you shall burn it with fire, both the city and all its spoils, entirely for the Lord your God.” … “Its spoils,” but not the spoils of Heaven. From here … stated: The consecrated … in it, … must be redeemed, and terumot … they must … decay. … second tithe and sacred scrolls … must be interred.

“Entirely [kalil] for the Lord your God,” Rabbi Shimon says: The Holy One, Blessed be He, says: If you implement judgment on an idolatrous city, I ascribe you … as though you have sacrificed an entirely [kalil] burnt offering before Me.

“And it shall be a heap forever” … shall not be converted … gardens and orchards; … the statement of Rabbi Yosei HaGelili. Rabbi Akiva says: … “It shall not be built again,” … to the way it was … it … not … built; but it may be converted into gardens and orchards. … “And there shall cleave nothing of that which was devoted to your hand” … as long as the wicked … in the world, … wrath in the world; … the wicked are eliminated from the world, wrath leaves the world.
GEMARA: The Sages taught … “are gone out” … they, … but not agents … “men” … men … no less than two. Alternatively, … Men, but not women; men, but not children.

“wicked persons [benei veliyya’al]” … Sons who have cast off the yoke of Heaven from their necks. … “from your midst” … but not … on the border. … “inhabitants of their city” … But not inhabitants of another city. … “saying” … that … one requires witnesses and forewarning for each and every one

It was stated … Rabbi Yoḥanan says: One divides one city into … two tribes; and Reish Lakish says: One does not divide one city into … two tribes. Rabbi Yoḥanan raised an objection to … Reish Lakish … Unless its subverters are from that city and from that tribe; what, is it not that although its subverters are from that city, if they are from that tribe, yes, … if not, no, … Conclude from it: One divides one city into … two tribes,
No, … where … fell to him as an inheritance … Alternatively, … where they gave him … as a gift.

raised an objection to … “Nine cities from those two tribes” … What, is it not … four-and-a-half from this … and four-and-a-half from that … and conclude from it … one divides one city into … two tribes? … No, … Four … from this … and five … from that
If so, let … state explicitly
a difficulty
A dilemma was raised before … subverted themselves … what is … the Merciful One states: “And have subverted,” … But not if they subvert themselves; or perhaps even … they subverted themselves
Come … hear … women or children subvert … Why … Let … be … as … they subverted themselves. … these, … are drawn after their own … Those, … are drawn after women and children

unless most of … are subverted. … How do we act … Rav Yehuda says: … judges … and … imprisons … judges and imprisons … Ulla said to him: … result in you delaying justice for those … Rather, Ulla says: … judges … and stones … judges and stones
It was stated … Rabbi Yoḥanan says: … judges and stones … judges and stones … And Reish Lakish says: One increases … courts for them

Is that so? But doesn’t Rabbi Ḥama bar Yosei say … Rabbi Oshaya says … “And you shall take that man or that woman out … You take a man and a woman out to your gates … but you do not take the entire city out to your gates; … Rather, … one increases … courts for them and … analyze their cases, … we take them to the High Court [Sanhedrin] and … issues … verdict of … and executes them.

“You shall smite the inhabitants of that city … The Sages taught … The caravan of donkeys and the caravan of camels that move from place to place, … lodged in … and were subverted with it, if they had stayed there thirty days they … by the sword and their property is destroyed. … less than that, they … by stoning, … and their property is spared.

And … raises a contradiction … How long shall … be in the city and … will be like … the residents of the city … twelve months, … Rava says: … not difficult, … This … to become … of the citizens of the city; this … to become … of the inhabitants of the city.

And … it is taught … one prohibited by a vow from deriving benefit from the citizens of the city, if there is a person who had stayed there twelve months, it is prohibited … to derive benefit from him. … less than that, it is permitted … to derive benefit from him. … from the inhabitants of the city, if … had stayed there thirty days, it is prohibited … to derive benefit from him. … less than that, it is permitted … to derive benefit from him.

“Destroy it utterly, and all that is in it” … The Sages taught … “Destroy it utterly, and all that is in it”; … to exclude the property of the righteous that is … outside … “And all that is in it”; … to include the property of the righteous that is … inside … “its spoils” … But not the spoils of Heaven; … “and … all of its spoils” … to include the property of the wicked that is … outside

Rabbi Shimon said: For what … does the Torah say … the property of the righteous that is in it shall be destroyed? … Who caused … to live in … their property … therefore, their property is destroyed. The Master said … “and you shall gather all of its spoils” … to include the property of the wicked that is … outside … Rav Ḥisda says: And … with regard to … gathered into

Rav Ḥisda says: Deposits of the inhabitants of an idolatrous city are permitted, … What are the circumstances? If we say … of another city and … is … within … obvious that … permitted, … not “its spoils”; … But rather, … belonging to … and … is … within another city. … if … that … gathered into … why are … permitted? … And if … cannot … gathered into … didn’t … say once

No, … actually … of another city that is deposited within … and what are we dealing with here? … where … assumes … responsibility for … Lest you say: Once he assumes … responsibility for … like … his own … teaches us

Rav Ḥisda says: An animal … half … of an idolatrous city and half … of another city … forbidden. … dough … half … of an idolatrous city and half … of another city, … permitted. … What is the reason … An animal is like an entity that is not divided, … Dough is like an entity that is divided.

Rav Ḥisda raises a dilemma: … the animal of an idolatrous city, what is … is ritual slaughter effective … in purifying it from … of an unslaughtered animal carcass? … the Merciful One states: … with the edge of the sword,” … it is no different … one ritually slaughtered … it is no different … one killed … Or perhaps, since one ritually slaughtered … ritual slaughter is effective. What … shall stand

Rav Yosef raises a dilemma: What is … the hair of pious women … Rava says: … that the hair of wicked … forbidden … “And you shall gather…and you shall burn” … is written, … that is lacking, … only gathering and burning … excluding this … which is lacking detaching, gathering, and burning.

Rather, Rava says: … with regard to a wig. … What are the circumstances? If … is attached to her body, … like … her body. … No, … is necessary … where … is hanging on a peg. Is … like … the property of the righteous inside … and … it is destroyed, or perhaps, since she enters and exits … like … a garment, … shall stand

“And you shall gather all of its spoils into the midst of its square” … the Sages taught: … has no square, it does not become an idolatrous city, … the statement of Rabbi Yishmael. Rabbi Akiva says: … has no square, one creates a square for … With regard to what … do they disagree? … Sage, … holds “its square” indicates … from the outset. And … Sage, … holds … “its square” … also indicate … now.

And the consecrated … in it must be redeemed. who is anointed with the anointing oil, … The Sages taught: “Anointed” … might … a king. … the verse states: “Priest.” If … a priest, … might … multiple garments. … the verse states: “Anointed.” If … anointed, … might … anointed for war. … the verse states: “And the anointed priest,” … that there is no anointed … over him;

might … all of … sacrifice … acute mourners. … the verse states: “For the consecration of the anointing oil of his God is upon him” … “Upon him,” … but not upon another … And after the verse differentiated … might … that he would not be commanded to … a virgin, … the verse states … “And he

occasion, Rav Pappa was sitting and he raised … dilemma. Huna, son of Rav Naḥman, said to Rav Pappa: We learn … I have … only … who stepped down … due to his seminal emission … From where … due to blemishes, … The verse states: “And he.” … he arose … kissed him on his head and gave him his daughter

omer … precedes the lamb that accompanies it; the two loaves, … precede the sheep that accompany them. This is the principle: A matter that comes due to … the day precedes a matter that comes due to … bread.
